priorityList: Use Reaver's Glaive if the buff is not active and you are not in an Essence Break window.
Use Death Sweep immediately if a DemonSurge charge is available.
Use Annihilation if a DemonSurge charge is available and Death Sweep is on cooldown.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative or Inertia, ideally right before Eye Beam or Essence Break.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown and you are not currently in a DemonSurge window.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Demonic and Fel-Scarred metamorphosis benefits.
Use Essence Break while in Metamorphosis if you have enough Fury and Blade Dance is nearly ready.
Use Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) on cooldown.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown, ideally when Essence Break is not active.
Use Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) to spend excess Fury, especially during Essence Break.
Use Felblade if Fury is low (below 40) or to generate Fury when moving into a burst window.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and maintain 'A Fire Inside' charges.
Use Fel Rush to consume an Inertia trigger if Vengeful Retreat is unavailable.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler if Soulscar is talented and all higher priority abilities are on cooldown.
Use Arcane Torrent if Fury is critically low (below 35) and you are in melee range.
